scope: Explicit generated 0.5mm trace / 3oz copper DRV8311 reference, not a hardware or independent controller-waveform qualification. Physical R, branch currents and all-phase 3D trace/via dL are independently reconstructed; excitation commands are exported from the Rust model.
cause: Via intervals now use actual copper-layer separation rather than a full PCB thickness per graph edge. Force sampling includes signed vertical via current. This default four-layer reference routes vias between layers 0 and 1, one-third of its 1.6mm PCB thickness.
limits: Current excitation is not an independently verified FOC/PWM waveform
Inductance/ampacity/thermal checks retain their analytical screening limits
Terminal fan-out and external return conductors are not modeled
No backplane material or finite housing motion validation
